Straight 90-degree overhead orthographic camera, top-down like a strategy-game map sprite, no perspective tilt. Sun from the upper left: keep the guide's lit and shaded faces exactly where they are. Hand-painted gritty science-fiction game-sprite look like Starsector, restrained palette, coarse readable detail that survives being shrunk to about 30 to 40 pixels per cell. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no ground or terrain, no grass, no cast shadow outside the objects, no extra slab, apron or border. Transparent background outside every silhouette (if transparency is impossible, a flat pure white background). Change only material, surface detail and subtle shading, never placement, size or silhouette.
